## SCOOP 


```{r, include=FALSE}
# import data base
data.survey <- read.csv("SCOOP_fish_data.csv")
data.samples <- read.csv("SCOOP_samples.csv")
```

```{r}
data <- merge(data.samples, data.survey, all.x = TRUE)

ggplot(subset(data, !SpeciesCode %in% c("BSS", "LIN", "POL", "NOP") & !is.na(SpeciesCode)), aes(Weight,Length))+
  geom_point()+
  facet_wrap(vars(SpeciesCode), scales = "free")
```
